answers.core: Cannot be done with an asset.
answers.workaround:
Writing `INF` or `NAN` in the inspector has no precedence… Since it didn't work. *Now it is bound to happen, and if anything you can point people here.*

However, honestly, it probably isn't a common use case, since a lot of things won't work with those values. For example RayCasts don't work https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/3389.

And yes, we have a workaround. We can use `INF` and `NAN`.
